item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
### Features - Add "+" button in notch header to create new tmux sessions running Claude Code. - Tmux sessions use claude-N naming with smallest available number. - Add trash button to kill individual tmux panes without affecting other sessions. - Show tmux session name badge in chat header. - Markdown links are now clickable — URLs open in browser, file paths open in Finder. - Working directory in chat header is clickable — opens folder in Finder and closes panel. - Bottom scroll fade gradient on instances list hints at more content below.
### Fixes - ThinkingView now shows full text with auto-wrap instead of truncated ellipsis. - Fix list item text wrapping in MarkdownRenderer cutting off long lines.
